e3aBehaviour.summary: The first request email (mission mail 'request received') button opens /account/rooms/<id> only when CORRIDRA_STATUS_LINK and CORRIDRA_UX_ROAD are both exactly 'true', else /account/requests/<id>. The link grants no authority. A signed-out visitor goes to /signin?next=<room path> and returns through the ADR-067 exact-path allowlist, which now also applies when the status-link switch is on (emailReturnPagesOn).
e3aBehaviour.sideEffectTested: With the status link on and Pulse off, /account/move and /account/notifications also become valid next= targets. This is navigation only: each page re-checks its own switch and sign-in first.
e3aBehaviour.unchanged: Mail words, recipient, transport and idempotency key. No mail is sent by the tests (recorder sender). No migration, no table, no installer run.
e3aBehaviour.realServerRedirectCheck: Reported by the builder, no receipt file exists under work/ and the scribe did not re-run it: with the switch on, a Room request answered 307 to /signin?next=%2Faccount%2Frooms%2F<uuid> then /signin?returnTo=...; with the switch off, with Pulse on or off, plain /signin in one hop; evil, protocol-relative, query, fragment and extra-path next values all fall back to plain /signin.
e3aBehaviour.review: Independent security review (as relayed by the conductor): traced no open redirect, no authentication grant, no new state-changing GET, and mail unchanged apart from the path; no blocking or should-fix defects.
